name: Amazon Rufus / Buy for Me → Alexa for Shopping
summary: Amazon's in-store AI shopping assistant (renamed from Rufus to Alexa for Shopping on 13 May 2026) that can auto-buy and, via Buy for Me, purchase on other retailers' sites.

claims.statement: Amazon's own launch article for Alexa for Shopping (13 May 2026); there is no standalone product URL.
claims.quote: Amazon brings together Rufus and Alexa+ to create ‘Alexa for Shopping’ on the Amazon Shopping app and website.
methods: curl -sL https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-ai-assistant (HTTP 200, title "Alexa for Shopping: Amazon's AI assistant for personalized shopping", article:published_time 2026-05-13)

history.statement: Amazon news page on Rufus (no standalone product URL)
history.quote: On May 13, 2026, Rufus was renamed Alexa for Shopping .
history.reason: Atlas screenshot review 2026-10-17: the old URL is the February 2024 "Amazon announces Rufus" article; replaced by Amazon's Alexa for Shopping launch article

claims.statement: The Alexa for Shopping launch article serves full content (HTTP 200), including the Buy for Me feature.
claims.quote: For eligible products, the Buy for Me agentic AI feature handles the entire purchase on your behalf using your primary address and credit card.

history.quote: Rufus is an expert shopping assistant trained on Amazon's product catalog
history.reason: Atlas screenshot review 2026-10-17: re-observed on the new website URL

claims.statement: Buy for Me purchases on other stores
claims.quote: Rufus can shop tens of millions of items in other online stores directly and make purchases on behalf of customers using its agentic Buy For Me feature.

claims.statement: Operator: 300M+ customers used Rufus in 2025; ~$12B incremental annualized sales
claims.quote: Rufus was used by 300 million+ customers ... helping deliver nearly $12 billion in incremental annualized sales last year.

claims.statement: Rename to Alexa for Shopping 2026-05-13; Amazon blocked Meta Muse from shopping its site (Sep 2026, Yahoo Finance excerpt)
claims.quote: On May 13, 2026, Rufus was renamed Alexa for Shopping
